text:
Olivia Nguyen: Hey — monitor + stand arrived, thanks. Missing the USB audio dongle that was supposed to be in the box, and my MacBook can't join corp-wifi: 802.1X auth keeps failing. First day, so not sure who to loop. Anyone help? 🙏
IT Support: Hi Olivia — welcome! Can you open a quick IT ticket? If you want we can start here. What's your shipping address? Also paste the exact error you're seeing for Wi‑Fi.
Olivia Nguyen: Thanks! Error popup says '802.1X authentication failed' when selecting CORP_WIFI. No config profile installed yet. Shipping address is 1234 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103.
Samir (Network Eng): @Olivia Nguyen try removing any old cert profiles: System Settings → Profiles → remove any 'Corp WiFi' entries. Then install the SCEP profile via: https://idp.redwood/internal/scep (it will prompt). If it still fails, run `sudo /usr/sbin/airport -I` and paste the output here.
Carmen (Logistics): Hey @IT Support — we show 'USB-A audio dongle' was backordered. I can overnight one to Olivia — need to confirm courier. @Olivia Nguyen is the SF address correct? ETA ~2 business days once I create label.
IT Support: Confirmed — I'll open ticket IT-4521 and attach the shipping request. Samir, if cert reinstall fails we can jump on a quick Zoom to grab logs.
inventory-bot: label-created: shipment 89821 for IT-4521 — carrier: FastSend, ETA: 48 hours.
Olivia Nguyen: Profile install worked! Had to accept the new certificate prompt and rejoin CORP_WIFI. Wi‑Fi is up. Thanks Samir :party_parrot: 
Carmen (Logistics): Great — I created the pickup and it's moving. You should get a tracking email shortly.
Olivia Nguyen: Got the tracking email. Thanks all! Tagging @Morgan (DevEx) — hi! where do I find onboarding docs for setting up git & slack? :)
Morgan (DevEx): Welcome @Olivia! Start here: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding/new-hire — includes git, slack, VPN, and common dev env steps. Ping me if anything missing. :wave:
Olivia Nguyen: Perfect. Thanks everyone. Will close IT-4521 when the dongle arrives. 🙌
